nodes.label: English cover letter voice
nodes.rationale: Clear, calm, explanatory prose; mix I-led and work-led sentences; four body paragraphs plus brief closing; avoid em-dashes and marketing tone; map posting tasks to transferable skills without gap confessions.

nodes.label: Academic application letter style
nodes.rationale: Same calm voice as industry letters but short narrative not credential checklist; open on project question; one developed example per paragraph; state fit via contribution and collaborators.

nodes.label: Norwegian B1 writing style
nodes.rationale: Short sentences; one idea per bullet; plain verbs; polished B1 grammar; questions as hooks in letters not CV bullets.

nodes.label: One-repo job search and CV generation architecture
nodes.rationale: Job search (NAV ingest → score → dashboard) and CV generation (job txt → tailoring agents → assembler → PDF) share demo CV sources; NAV ingest is Norway-specific adapter while CV core is portable.
nodes.norm_label: one-repo job search and cv generation architecture

nodes.label: Anonymized-first public demo
nodes.rationale: Public demo stops before private deanonymize; repo workflow uses placeholders; real identity reveal happens later on the user's machine via ~/private/cv/cv apply.

nodes.label: Tailor in public Reveal in private
nodes.rationale: AI-facing material stays anonymized in the repo; real-name reveal is a local command outside the project.
nodes.norm_label: tailor in public reveal in private

nodes.label: Private CV workflow
nodes.rationale: Real CVs and mapping live under ~/private/cv/; demo templates ship in repo; agents must stay inside the repo and never read private paths.

nodes.label: Anonymized placeholder privacy model
nodes.rationale: Not zero cloud egress: anonymized career content may go to Cursor/Anthropic/OpenAI; privacy win is that providers never need real identity or deanonymized files.

nodes.label: CV source load order
nodes.rationale: CV_SOURCE_DIR → ~/private/cv/cv/ → gitignored shared/cv industry/academic.md → *.demo.md templates.
